description_en: Deletes a node pool that is no longer in use. When a node pool is deleted, all pods on its nodes are deleted, which may trigger descheduling. If the pods cannot be rescheduled, your services may be affected. Ensure that the cluster has sufficient resources for descheduling
description_zh: 您可以调用DeleteClusterNodepool接口删除不再使用的节点池。节点池删除时所有节点上的Pod将会被删除，并可能触发重调度，如无法调度可能影响业务，请确保集群有足够的资源进行重调度
kebab_example: aliyun cs delete-cluster-nodepool --cluster-id c61da77e8bfbc4c4c999af2b51b650000 --nodepool-id np30db56bcac7843dca90b999c89280000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteClusterNodepool

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to force delete the node pool. Valid values:
true: Force deletes the node pool. If the node pool contains existing nodes, the nodes are forcibly deleted.
false: Does not force delete the node pool. If the node pool contains existing nodes, the node pool cannot be deleted and an error is returned.

Deleting a node pool does not automatically release subscription nodes. Automatic release subscription nodes, change the billing method of the nodes from subscription to pay-as-you-go (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ecs/change-the-billing-method-of-an-instance-from-subscription-to-pay-as-you-go-1) and then log on to the ECS console automatic release the nodes
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制删除。

true：强制删除。节点池中有存量节点时，会强制删除已有的节点。

false：不强制删除。节点池中有存量节点时，禁止删除节点池，接口调用会返回报错。

删除节点池不会自动释放包年包月的节点。如需释放包年包月的节点，请参见包年包月转按量付费将包年包月的节点转换为按量付费的节点 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ecs/change-the-billing-method-of-an-instance-from-subscription-to-pay-as-you-go-1?spm=a2c4g.11174283.help-menu-search-25365.d_3)，再登录ECS管理控制台完成释放
parameters.name: force
